units.source_text: 好容易喝完了，他近乎道歉地把水壶口揿到女人嘴里。

en.t: When he had finally finished drinking, he pressed the mouth of the canteen to the woman's lips almost apologetically.

units.source_text: 女人咬住水壶口，口也不漱，就像鸽子似的咕嘟咕嘟喝了起来。

en.t: The woman bit down on the mouth of the canteen and, without even rinsing her mouth, began gulping it down like a pigeon.

units.source_text: 才喝了三口，水壶就空了。

en.t: After only three swallows, the canteen was empty.

units.source_text: 浮肿的眼皮底下，女人那双直勾勾盯着男人的眼睛，第一次蕴含了不可原谅的责难。

en.t: Beneath her swollen eyelids, the woman's eyes, staring fixedly at the man, held an unforgivable accusation for the first time.
The empty canteen was as light as if it were made of paper.
